request.style: English, solemn female voice with chorus, organ, strings, tambourine, lyre, majestic and joyful, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Praise the LORD with a new song
His praise in the assembly of the faithful
Let Israel rejoice in his Maker
Let the children of Zion exult in their King

[Chorus]
Sing to the LORD a new song
Praise him with dancing and sound
Tambourine and lyre ring out
For he delights in his people

[Verse]
The humble are crowned with salvation
Let the faithful exult in glory
Sing for joy upon your beds
For the LORD has made you new

[Chorus]
Sing to the LORD a new song
Praise him with dancing and sound
Tambourine and lyre ring out
For he delights in his people

[Bridge]
Exaltation of God in their mouths
A two-edged sword in their hands
Vengeance on the nations
Punishment on the peoples

[Outro]
A new song to the LORD
Praise in the assembly
